scope: Derived operating policy for pinned ARX belt P5, not latest ARX: remove the sideways transfer tilt while retaining forward tilt, source roll, TCP targets and IK equations. Transfer runs at half rate and loaded descent at one fifth rate. Rate changes occur at stationary source phase boundaries; finite-difference join residuals are measured. The source task remains available with lateral_tilt_scale=1. Motor, brake, spring, belt and contact ratings are unchanged. This does not retain the payload during power loss or qualify hardware.
